content:
Apple’s new iPhone 18 Pro cases and other accessories are now available in Apple Stores. Pre-orders for the new phones start tomorrow ahead of the launch in one week.

New accessories include cases for iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max, plus items that work with other products.

The other bit of good news is that iPhone 18 Pro cases are compatible with iPhone 17 Pro phones. That’s helpful if you like a new color or style of case made for the new phones but don’t plan to upgrade.

The lineup includes Apple’s $49 Silicone Case and redesigned Clear Case with MagSafe, along with the refreshed $59 TechWoven Case.

Apple is also selling updated FineWoven Wallet colors and the familiar $59 Crossbody Strap in a wider range of options.

The most interesting addition is Apple’s new $29 Wrist Strap. It attaches to compatible Apple cases and can also be used with AirPods Pro 2 and AirPods Pro 3.

The 15.4-inch strap uses 100% recycled polyester yarn and includes flexible embedded magnets that help it stay neatly aligned around your wrist.

Apple offers the Wrist Strap in black, taupe, olive, crisp blue, magenta, and burgundy.

It works with Apple’s TechWoven, Silicone, and Clear cases for iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max, plus several cases made for the iPhone 17 lineup.
